prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We are assembling your pet's 3D model, animations, and desktop interaction scripts.", "Generating character model and textures", "Configuring desktop companion movement physics", "Finalizing voice and interaction responses"]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop", "Your companion is ready to live on your screen.", "Start Desktop Experience"]
2: ["Choose Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Select your companion persona", "Live Motion Preview"]
3: ["Signing into your account safely restores all your previously adopted pets and data."]
4: ["Official Pet Adoption & Personalization", "Give your desktop pet a name", "Select companion behavior style"]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the desktop to open quick interactions or send it to sleep."]
6: ["Welcome Your New Companion to Your Desktop", "Place Pet on Desktop"]
7: ["Use bright, front-facing lighting with clear facial visibility for best custom pet generation.", "Best results: Bright room, straight-on camera angle"]
8: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Continue with Google", "Syncing saves pet progress across devices."]
9: ["Adopt a Companion That Lives On Your Desktop", "Choose or build a pet that walks around your screen, responds to your clicks, and keeps you company while you work.", "Start Adoption Journey"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for user's facial visibility and photo data.
